intent: One question of a Questionnaire, a fieldset that is shown and interactive only while it is the current item.

dont_use_when.situation: A group of related fields shown together in an ordinary form

invariants.text: Every rendered item stays mounted; all but the current one carry the native `hidden` and `inert` attributes, and a `disabled` item is always hidden; it is left out of navigation and progress when its `items` entry is disabled too, or when the root has no `items`.

The status is `answered` once an enabled choice is checked or the freeform field holds non-blank text, `skipped` after QuestionnaireSkip, and `unanswered` otherwise; it is stamped as `data-status`, and `onStatusChange` is called with each new value.

The item passes validation when answered, or when it is optional and skipped; an untouched optional item fails exactly like a required one. `invalid` fails it even when answered, until an optional item is skipped.

Without `multiple` the choices are radios and the item holds one answer: a checked choice and a filled freeform field replace each other. With `multiple` every choice is a checkbox and any number may be checked.
`name` matches the item's `items` entry and is the form field name its answer submits under; a skipped item submits nothing under it.

anti_patterns.dont: Give a QuestionnaireItem a `required` or `disabled` that differs from its `items` entry
anti_patterns.do_instead: Keep both in step. The root reads the entry for Skip's visibility and the flow, while the item's own props decide its validation and Skip's effect, so a mismatch shows a Skip that does nothing or hides one an optional item needs

anti_patterns.dont: Omit QuestionnaireError from an optional item
anti_patterns.do_instead: Render a QuestionnaireError in every item; Next never disables itself, so a failed Next on an untouched optional item is otherwise silent

a11y.by: questionnaire.test.tsx asserts the inactive item's fieldset has the hidden property and the inert attribute, and that the current item carries data-status "unanswered" after a blocked Next

onStatusChange.states: onStatusChange is a callback, not a value
onStatusChange.because: A function type has no JSON Schema representation. It is `(status: 'unanswered' | 'answered' | 'skipped') => void`.

good.title: A required single-choice item
good.code:
<QuestionnaireItem name="role" required>
  <QuestionnaireTitle>What is your role?</QuestionnaireTitle>
  <QuestionnaireDescription>Pick one.</QuestionnaireDescription>
  <QuestionnaireChoices>
    <QuestionnaireChoice value="engineer">Engineer</QuestionnaireChoice>
    <QuestionnaireChoice value="designer">Designer</QuestionnaireChoice>
  </QuestionnaireChoices>
  <QuestionnaireError />
</QuestionnaireItem>

bad.title: Required on the item but not in items
bad.code:
<Questionnaire items={[{ name: 'role', choices: [{ value: 'engineer' }] }]}>
  <QuestionnaireItem name="role" required>{question}</QuestionnaireItem>
</Questionnaire>
bad.why: The root reads `required` from the `items` entry, so it shows Skip, while the item's own `required` makes that Skip do nothing.

onStatusChange.description: TS: ((status: QuestionnaireItemStatus) => void) | undefined. The compiler emits one JSON type per property; this type is left to tsc. onStatusChange is a callback, not a value. A function type has no JSON Schema representation. It is `(status: 'unanswered' | 'answered' | 'skipped') => void`.
